name: Tetra-NeRF
definition: A radiance field representation that uses a dense set of non-overlapping tetrahedra obtained by Delaunay triangulation of an input point cloud to represent the scene, replacing uniform voxel grids or sparse point clouds.
summary: Tetra-NeRF is a radiance field representation using Delaunay tetrahedra to provide a continuous, adaptive structure with constant complexity, avoiding the empty regions of sparse methods and fixed resolution of voxels.
